description: This file defines a React component called MultiverseExplorerView which provides a UI for exploring career paths through a multiverse concept. The component fetches data from API endpoints, manages user interactions like bookmarking paths, selecting paths and target roles, and displays detailed information and visualizations such as mindmaps and role cards.

methods.name: normalizeBackendBookmarksToLocal
methods.description: Converts API bookmark records into local bookmark objects, sorting them by creation date.

methods.name: normalizeRecommendedRoles
methods.description: Transforms raw API data of recommended roles into a structured array with specific fields for UI rendering.

methods.name: roleIdFromRec
methods.description: Generates a stable role ID string from a role recommendation object for use in the UI.

methods.name: roleTitleFromRec
methods.description: Extracts the role title from a recommendation object.

methods.name: labelForPathType
methods.description: Converts a MultiversePathType enum value into a human-readable label.

methods.name: describePathType
methods.description: Provides a textual description for each MultiversePathType.

methods.name: looksLikePathType
methods.description: Type guard to check if a string is one of the valid MultiversePathType values.

methods.name: pathMatchesFilters
methods.description: Determines whether a career path fits the current search query, industry, and skills filters.
